Name: Tree Size Framework
Author: EnderTedi
Description:
Tree Size Framework is a simple framework mod which allows content modders to create trees with heights outside of the vanilla limit, allowing the creation of taller (or smaller!) trees.

[b][size=5]Installation
[/size]
[/b]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]the latest version of SMAPI.
[/url]2. Download and install this mod.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=5][b]Usage For Players[/b][/size]
This mod does nothing on its own. There is no benefit to installing this as a user if another mod that you are using does not require it.

[size=5][b]Usage For Modders
[/b][/size]See [url=https://github.com/EnderTedi/Tree-Size-Framework/blob/master/Docs/Readme.MD]the Documentation on Github

[/b][/size]See ﻿[url=https://github.com/EnderTedi/Tree-Size-Framework]the Source Code[/url]
